## How to use
1. Point any website form / GoHighLevel form webhook at this trigger URL.
2. Expected JSON: { "name", "email", "phone", "service", "message" }
3. Add your OpenAI, Gmail and Google Sheets credentials below, then activate.
4. Hot leads (score >= 70) get an instant personal email; everyone is logged.
